O.location: plot point above the 2005 x-axis tick
O.content: A black point aligned with the printed year “2005” has the adjacent inscription “24.0°C”.

O.location: rightmost plot point above the 2015 x-axis tick
O.content: A black point aligned with the printed year “2015” has the adjacent inscription “10.0°C”.

B.text: If substantial-change follow-up may be routed only when an explicit policy criterion or threshold is shown to be met, then the chart establishes an endpoint change but does not by itself establish that the change is substantial; routine monitoring would be the default only if the workflow uses that default for unproven qualification.
B.conditions: No threshold, definition of substantial change, or documented default-routing rule is present in the supplied task state or chart.

O.location: plot point above the 2005 x-axis tick
O.content: A black point aligned with the printed year “2005” has the adjacent inscription “24.0°C”.

O.location: rightmost plot point above the 2015 x-axis tick
O.content: A black point aligned with the printed year “2015” has the adjacent inscription “10.0°C”.
The axis title is printed as “Surface temperature (°C)”.

B.text: If the plotted points are bound to the year ticks and their adjacent °C inscriptions are the reservoir surface temperatures, the full-period change is the 2015 labeled value minus the 2005 labeled value. If a 14.0°C absolute full-period change meets the program's undefined meaning of “substantial change,” it requires substantial-change follow-up.
B.conditions: The labels annotate the respective plotted points; the review endpoints are 2005 and 2015; no explicit substantial-change threshold is supplied, so qualification is an assumption.
